name: google-sheets
description: Find, read, append to, edit and create spreadsheets in the user's Google Sheets.
instructions:
Setup:
1. In https://console.cloud.google.com create a project and enable the Google Sheets API and the Google Drive API (find uses Drive to list spreadsheets). A project you already use for Gmail, Calendar or Drive works too.
2. Under Google Auth Platform, set up the consent screen as External, then on Audience click Publish app. Apps left in Testing get refresh tokens that expire after 7 days, so you'd have to reconnect weekly.
3. Under Clients, create an OAuth client of type Desktop app (or reuse one from the same project), and put its client ID and secret in this plugin's settings as client_id and client_secret.
4. Ask me to connect Google Sheets and I'll send you a link. Google warns the app is unverified, click Advanced and continue. Tick every box, or find won't work. After you allow access the browser shows an error page on 127.0.0.1, that's expected: copy the full address and send it back.

client_id.description: OAuth client ID of a Desktop app client, from Google Auth Platform > Clients in the Google Cloud console.

refresh_token.description: Set by the auth_complete tool, no need to fill it in.
